scores.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across tool rounds while ignoring missing rounds and preserving undefined when no rounds report usage. It meets all acceptance criteria, including testing a turn with two tool rounds (three provider calls), leaving the existing single-round test untouched, and updating the spec and CHANGELOG. To make the hook signature unambiguous as requested, the candidate introduces a structurally identical `TurnUsage` interface in `src/types/ai.ts`, whereas the reference simply renames the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and updates `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`. Finally, the candidate places the new tests in two separate test files (`chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts` and `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts`) rather than adding them directly to the existing `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` suite.
